result.brief: 提出潜空间专家认知链，用紧凑潜 token 承载 DINOv3 视觉、SAM3 语义与深度几何表征，按课程学习逐步注入，构建稠密潜世界表征以提升 VLA 驾驶感知与规划。
result.reason: Injects latent expert tokens to internalize DINOv3/SAM3/depth representations into a VLA model, forming dense latent world representations—a representation-learning contribution, though applied to driving.
